section.heading: Setup
section.text: The Uber variant for the Echoing Strike Warlock alters its Skill Tree to be able to Bind a Demon to serve as a tank. The desired Demon would be a Pit Lord from the Furnace of Pain, due to it being naturally Immune to most damage types other than Physical and Magic. This makes for tanky enough of a pet to survive Uber Tristram and the Colossal Ancients. You also need to stack as much -xx% Enemy Resistance as possible without tanking the build's Resistances. Hellwarden's Will + Sling and a Sunder Charm with -xx% Enemy Magic Resistance more than doubles your damage output. Make sure to replace a Gheed's Fortune with more damage or survivability, if you're using one. Prebuffing with Demon Limb and Treachery Breast Plate gives better Attack Rating and Survivability.
